description: Use when the human asks to move a client (company) and all its projects, forms, submissions, and files into another workspace they own. Public keys, snippets, inbox links, and webhook secrets stay the same, so the live site needs no change. Needs an owner of both teams (dashboard session or operator token; team-scoped tokens cannot). Refused when the destination has a client with the same slug (pass slug), when a free destination would pass 3 projects, or when the client has text alert numbers and the destination has no Twilio. Confirm the destination team name with the human first. Do not use this to rename or archive.

client_id.description: Client id from list_clients or create_client.

slug.description: New client slug, only when the destination team already has a client with this one.

team_id.description: Destination team id from list_teams. You must own it and the client's current team.

name: move_client
title: Move client to another team
